decisions.reason: Because this compact dumper builds directly on our established compact site equipment, our existing engineering, service and customer knowledge give us high absorptive capacity to refine it rather than withdraw it.

As an articulated construction dumper closely aligned with our core construction machinery offer, it fits our accumulated know-how and commercial-service base, so continued improvement is more likely than exit.
This telescopic loader line remains strongly connected to our core competences, and the several-model rollout indicates sufficient internal learning and commitment to continue developing the range.

The material lift is close to our established lifting equipment knowledge and the reported large order confirms strong market acceptance that we can exploit and improve through our own R&D and service capabilities.

Although the compact underground mining loader is more distant from our established offer, the intensive early field use shows clear customer value and gives us enough real-world feedback to learn and build capability, so we keep it with a higher residual withdrawal risk than the core-related products.
